items.title: Barcode values (one per line)
items.description: The numbers or text to encode, one barcode per line. GTIN types (EAN-13, UPC-A, ITF-14) accept the number with or without its check digit; when omitted, the check digit is computed for you.

barcodeType.title: Barcode type
barcodeType.description: Applied to all lines in the run. EAN-13 and UPC-A for retail products, ITF-14 for shipping cartons, Code 128 for logistics and internal SKUs, Code 39 for legacy systems, ISBN for books.

format.title: Image format
format.description: PNG for label printers and documents, SVG for infinite-resolution vector use.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Pixel width of the narrowest bar (PNG). 2-3 suits most label printers.

barHeight.title: Bar height (mm)
barHeight.description: Height of the bars in millimeters.

showText.title: Print the number under the bars
showText.description: Include the human-readable digits below the barcode.
